text: Ossified means hardened and stuck, like soft tissue turning into bone. Here it describes a gaming world where the same few franchises top the charts and newcomers rarely break through.
To jettison is to throw something away on purpose to lighten a load, like sailors tossing cargo overboard. Here Xbox dropped its smaller studios to focus on its big, reliable hits.
Irreverent means disrespectful toward things people usually take seriously, often in a funny way. Here it describes the GTA series' joking, mocking humour.
Vice City is the fictional city in the Grand Theft Auto games, a copy of Miami, Florida. It is the main setting of the new game.
Leonida is the game's make-believe version of the state of Florida, where Vice City sits.
Grand Theft Auto VI, or GTA VI, is the sixth main game in a hugely popular series from the studio Rockstar. The article calls it the most eagerly awaited video game in history.
Small-time means minor and not very important. Small-time crooks are petty criminals who pull off little crimes rather than big ones.
Inauspicious means not promising, a sign that things may go badly. Here the couple's first meeting, while stealing the same car, is an odd way to begin a partnership.
To be on the run means to be escaping from the police or from danger.
Partners in crime are people who do wrong or mischievous things together. The phrase is often used jokingly for close friends. In the game the two characters really are criminals.
Eagerly awaited means something people are very excited to see. Here, fans waited 13 years for this game.
Rumours are stories passed around that may not be true. For years fans swapped rumours about when the game would come out.
Gross means total money earned before costs are taken out. The highest-grossing launch is the one that brought in the most money in its first days.
Avengers: Endgame is a 2019 Marvel superhero film and one of the biggest movie debuts ever. Analysts think the new game could beat its opening.
Metacritic is a website that gathers reviews of games, films and music and turns them into one average score. The article calls it a review aggregator.
An aggregator is a service that collects things from many sources into one place, such as reviews or news stories.
GTA flu is a joking name for staff calling in sick, when they are really staying home to play the game. The article says employers expect an epidemic of it.
Improbably means in a way you would not expect. An improbably touching love story is a surprise in a crime game.
Astonishingly means in a way that is amazingly surprising. Here the game world looks astonishingly lifelike.
To conceal is to hide. Here the huge excitement about the game hides a deeper problem for the industry.
A franchise is a game or film series that keeps producing sequels, like Call of Duty or GTA, with a built-in audience.
A relative newcomer is new only when compared with the others. Fortnite is nine years old, which is young next to games that are 23 or 29 years old.
Call of Duty is a long-running series of military shooting games, one of the best-selling in the world. The article says it is 23 years old.
Fortnite is a free online game by Epic Games where players battle each other and buy costumes and items. It is run as a live-service game.
Steam is the biggest online store and platform for buying and playing games on a personal computer.
To rack up is to collect a large amount of something, like points or play time.
Circana is a market-research firm that tracks what people buy, including video games.
A market-research firm studies what people buy and like, and sells those findings to companies.
Barriers are things that block the way in. Here, the huge cost and effort of making a game stop new companies from entering.
New entrants are newcomers to an industry. Established firms often have big advantages over them.
Painstakingly means with great care and effort, paying attention to every small detail.
Eccentric means odd or unusual in an interesting way. The game's world is filled with quirky characters.
Photographic realism means pictures that look as real as a photograph. Here, nearly every part of the game world is drawn that way.
A blockbuster is a hugely successful and expensive film or product, aimed at a mass audience.
Manpower means the number of workers needed for a job. Bigger games need many more people.
Closing credits are the list of everyone who worked on a film or game, shown at the end.
Swollen means grown bigger than usual, as when budgets balloon. Here game budgets have grown larger than Hollywood's.
This is a comparison to something nearly impossible: building a huge pyramid on the world's tallest mountain. A developer used it to describe how hard the game was to make.
Ego is a person's sense of self-importance. Big egos mean people who think very highly of themselves.
A bet here means a risky investment. Companies are putting their money behind a few large projects instead of many small ones.
Xbox is Microsoft's video-game console and gaming business, which competes with Sony's PlayStation.
Studios are the companies or teams that make games, like film studios make movies.
Minecraft is a hugely popular building game in which players dig and construct things out of blocks. It is owned by Microsoft.
Live service means a game that keeps changing with new content and earns money for years through in-game purchases, instead of being sold once.
A single-player game is meant to be played alone, in contrast with online games played with other people.
Open-ended means with no fixed finish. An open-ended online game has no ending, so people keep playing.
Concord was a Sony online shooting game launched in 2024 at great expense. It was shut down after only two weeks because few people played it.
A nine-figure number has nine digits, which means at least 100 million. So the game's budget was reportedly over $100 million.
A shooter is a type of video game where players fight using weapons from a first- or third-person view.
Lukewarm means only slightly warm. Used for opinions, it means unenthusiastic.
To hone is to sharpen and improve a skill through practice.
A steep cost is a very high price. Steep literally means a sharp slope, so the phrase suggests a high climb.
A black hole pulls in everything and lets nothing out. Black-hole games draw in players so strongly that they rarely leave for another game.
To shake up a market means to change it greatly, so the old leaders lose their grip.
Epic Games is the company behind Fortnite. Its boss, Tim Sweeney, is quoted in the article.
A golden age is a time when something is at its best and most successful.
Data centres are huge buildings full of computers that run online services and AI. They use large amounts of computer memory.
RAMageddon blends RAM, a computer's memory, with Armageddon, the end of the world. It is a joking name for the memory shortage and price jump caused by AI demand.
To lay off workers means to end their jobs, usually to save money, not because of their performance.
Enders Analysis is a research firm that studies media, telecoms and technology businesses.
Spec is short for specification, the technical power of a device. Lower-spec devices are less powerful and cheaper.
This is a joke: games designed to run even on a very weak device, as if a toaster could run them.
To strike gold means to find great success, like a miner finding gold.
Computing muscle means processing power, the strength of a device's computer chips.
Portability is how easy something is to carry around. The Switch can be played anywhere.
To gravitate toward something is to be drawn to it naturally, as if pulled.
Roblox is a free platform where millions of games are made by its users. It is very popular with young children.
Cheap and cheerful describes something low-cost but good enough and fun, without fancy extras.
Hardcore gamers are the most dedicated players, who spend lots of time and money on games.
Gestation is the time a baby grows before birth. Used here for a project, it means the long period of development before release.
One-of-a-kind means unique, with nothing else like it.
